units.source_text: 她的头发一向是妹尼僧替她梳的，现在也不肯让他人触碰，自己梳又很不便，于是只将发端略微解开一点。

en.t: Her hair had always been combed for her by the younger nun, but now she would not let anyone else touch it, and it was very inconvenient to comb it herself, so she merely loosened the ends a little.

units.source_text: 她想起现在这姿态不能叫母亲再见一面，觉得虽是自己决心出家，实在也很可悲。

en.t: Thinking that she could not let her mother see her once more in this state, she felt that although becoming a nun was her own decision, it was still truly sorrowful.

units.source_text: 想是由于久病之故，她的头发略有脱落，然而并不稀疏，还是非常浓密，

en.t: Perhaps because of her long illness, some of her hair had fallen out, yet it was not at all thin and was still very thick,

units.source_text: 长达六尺左右，发端特别丰丽，根根毛发都有光彩，实在非常美观。

en.t: reaching about six feet in length; the ends were especially full and beautiful, every strand had a sheen, and it was truly splendid to behold.

units.source_text: 她独自吟唱“我母预期我披”之歌。

en.t: She quietly sang to herself the poem, “My mother had hoped to see me wear it.”
